scenario: Logical and comparison operators per LEXP.1 — and, or, not, ==, !=, <, <=, >, >=.
rules_ds:
schema T scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule and_rule:
    T t where t.v > 2 and t.v < 8
->
    log critical "and"

rule or_rule:
    T t where t.v == 1 or t.v == 5
->
    log critical "or"

rule not_rule:
    T t where not t.v == 99
->
    log critical "not"

rule neq:
    T t where t.v != 4
->
    log critical "neq"

rule lte:
    T t where t.v <= 5
->
    log critical "lte"

rule gte:
    T t where t.v >= 5
->
    log critical "gte"
